items.t: 3 Oilfield Services Stocks Set to Thrive Amid Industry Headwinds
items.sum: Strict capital discipline by upstream energy companies is acting as a dampener, making the outlook for the Zacks Oil and Gas-Field Services industry gloomy. FTI, BKR and HAL are expected to survive the industry woes.

items.sum: Atlas Energy Solutions fell 9.8% on Tuesday, Nov. 24, after Goldman Sachs lowered its price target on the frac sand producer to $6.00.

items.t: Invest in the Companies Behind Every Oil Well for Passive Income: $90,000 Across These 3 Oilfield Service Stocks Pays More Than $1,900 a Year
items.sum: Oil prices spiked to $138 and are forecast to slide, yet some companies get paid on every well drilled regardless of who owns the barrels. Three of them are sliding in price while their yields climb, and each carries a risk worth knowing.
